# ToolKiti - Complete API Reference for AI Agents
> Generated: 2026-08-02 | Total: 107 APIs | Updated daily
> This file is optimized for LLM ingestion. Every API includes structured metadata for agent decision-making.

---

## 大语言模型 (17 APIs)

### [HOT] OpenAI API (OpenAI 接口)
- Page: https://toolkiti.org/api/openai
- Website: https://openai.com
- Docs: https://platform.openai.com/docs
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go (per token)
- Status: online
- Popularity: 100/100
- Auth: API Key (Bearer Token)
- Endpoints: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings, https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations, https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions
- SDKs: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, curl
- Rate Limit: 10000 req/min (varies by tier)
- Latency: <500ms (GPT-4o)
- Max Context: 128K (GPT-4o)
- Features:
  - GPT-4o, GPT-4, GPT-3.5 model family
  - Multimodal: vision, audio, text generation
  - Function calling & structured outputs
  - Embeddings API for semantic search
  - Fine-tuning for custom models
- Usage Tips:
  - Use gpt-4o for complex reasoning, gpt-4o-mini for simple tasks to save cost
  - Set max_tokens to control response length and cost
  - Use streaming for real-time chat experiences
  - Store API keys in environment variables, never in code
- Description: 通过 REST API 调用 GPT-4o、GPT-4、GPT-3.5、Embeddings、DALL-E、Whisper 和 TTS 模型。

### [POPULAR] Anthropic Claude API (Anthropic Claude 接口)
- Page: https://toolkiti.org/api/anthropic
- Website: https://anthropic.com
- Docs: https://docs.anthropic.com
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go (per token)
- Status: online
- Popularity: 87/100
- Auth: API Key (x-api-key header)
- Endpoints: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages, https://api.anthropic.com/v1/complete
- SDKs: Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, curl
- Rate Limit: 4000 req/min (Tier 4)
- Latency: <800ms (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
- Max Context: 200K
- Features:
  - Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Haiku, Opus models
  - Extended thinking for complex reasoning
  - Computer use (beta) for GUI interaction
  - Vision & document analysis
  - Constitutional AI safety
- Usage Tips:
  - Claude excels at long-form writing and analysis with 200K context
  - Use the extended thinking mode for complex problem-solving
  - System prompts work best when they are specific and structured
- Description: 调用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Haiku 和 Opus 模型进行对话、分析和代码生成。

### Replicate API (Replicate 接口)
- Page: https://toolkiti.org/api/replicate
- Website: https://replicate.com
- Docs: https://replicate.com/docs
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go (per prediction)
- Status: online
- Popularity: 73/100
- Auth: API Key
- Endpoints: https://api.replicate.com/v1/models, https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions
- SDKs: Python, Node.js, curl
- Features:
  - Thousands of open-source ML models
  - Llama, Stable Diffusion, Whisper
  - Serverless API with autoscaling
  - Custom model deployment
  - Pay-per-prediction pricing
- Description: 云端运行开源机器学习模型，支持 Llama、Stable Diffusion、Whisper 等数千个模型。

- Page: https://toolkiti.org/api/huggingface

- Docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/api-inference
- Pricing: free tier, pay-as-you-go for accelerated inference
- Status: online
- Popularity: 50/100
- Auth: API Key (Bearer Token)
- Endpoints: https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/{model_id}
- SDKs: Python, JavaScript, curl
- Features:
  - 200,000+ models for inference
  - Transformers, diffusion, audio
  - Free inference API
  - Accelerated inference available
  - Community-driven model hub
- Description: 访问 20 万+ 模型进行推理，包括 Transformer、扩散模型和音频模型。
